pcs.pc_description: obtain the information and instructions from supervisor about the production schedule

ensure that required quantity of raw material i.e., nickel plated steel sheet (container), manganese dioxide powder and graphite/coal dust (cathode), zinc powder (anode), potassium hydroxide solution (electrolyte), gelling agent, brass pins, paper or fibrous fabric (separator), sealing plug, negative cap, sealant etc. are available as per the production plan and job requirements
ensure that raw material is as per the required and approved quality
prepare the assembly line for the alkaline battery manufacturing process
check that assembly line is functioning properly before starting the manufacturing process
adhere to all safety norms (such as wearing protective gloves and shoes, etc.) in accordance with the international/ national and organisational standards
start the assembly line and perform battery manufacturing process by following SOP
set the mixers and their parameters as per the SOP
fill the manganese dioxide powder, graphite/coal dust, electrode, sealing agent etc. in mixers to prepare cathode tablets/rings/powder as per the organisational standards and procedures
fill zinc powder with potassium hydroxide solution and gelling agent in mixers to prepare anode gel as per the organisational standards and procedures
ensure that cathode and anode are free from any foreign articles, dust, other metals

feed the nickel-plated steel sheet through the cutters, coaters and rollers for performing cutting, trimming and carbon coating operation and preparing the steel container of the battery by following SOP
move the steel cans to next section of assembly line for inserting and pressing the required quantity of cathode tablets/rings/powder in the steel can by following SOP

move the steel containers through to next section where a paper strip is rolled into a small tube and sealed on the bottom, formed separator and then it is inserted into the middle of the cathode rings
add electrolyte inside the battery container after the separator as per SOP
move the steel container to next section, where the zinc gel (anode) is injected into the inner part of the separator

move the steel container for last section where a brass nail, plastic seal ring and metal bottom is inserted into the steel can and the metal container is sealed to complete the manufacturing of battery by following SOP
follow shutdown procedures in case of any emergency/ normal process as per the SOP
report any issues faced (if any) during the production process to the supervisor
collect the manufactured batteries into bins or plastic trays as per organisational guidelines and procedures
check the batteries for any defect, charge leakage, appropriate voltage and amperage ratings by following SOP
segregate the defective and correct batteries into different bins as per organisational guidelines and procedures
carry out labelling and packaging of batteries as per organisational guidelines and procedures
send the final packaged batteries to the store room as per SOP
clean the equipment properly as per SOP after completion of work
dispose waste material into the disposal area in accordance with the company's policies and environmental regulations
update and maintain the log book with details of production output, material usage, lot number, batch number etc. to facilitate the traceability

modules.module_title: Perform maintenance activities of the battery

pcs.pc_description: perform basic health check-up of battery as specified in the manufacturer manual
check that the battery is clean, dry, free of dirt and grime
inspect the battery case, terminals, screws, clamps and cables for breakage, damage or loose connections
ensure that battery terminals, screws, clamps and cables clean, tight and free of corrosion
check battery for any sign of electrolyte leakage, overheating or overcharging
check that battery has sufficient electrolyte covering the battery plates in case of maintainable battery
use distilled or demineralised water for top up the electrolyte in battery, do not over fill as the fluid levels will rise when the battery is fully charged and may overflow
check the battery's state of charge by checking State of Charge Indicator on top of the battery that will give an on-the-spot diagnosis of the battery condition
perform open-circuit voltage test by using a voltmeter to determine the stabilised voltage and specific gravity test by using a hydrometer to determine the specific gravity (SG) of the electrolyte
replace/pair the battery as per the requirement and battery condition
recharge the battery (if required) by using an appropriate charger and following the instructions given in manufacturer manual
clean and tighten the battery case, terminals, screws, clamps and cables and ensure that they are free from dirt, grime and corrosion by following the instructions given in manufacturer manual
apply a thin coating of high temperature grease to posts and cable connections for added protection
assess when the problem is beyond his competence and report the problem to suitably qualified/designated and competent personnel
